title: 高盛副主席卡普兰：新美联储主席的谨慎信号
speaker: Rob Kaplan

segments.en: Joining us now from Dallas is Rob Kaplan, Goldman Sachs' vice chairman and former Dallas Fed president.
segments.zh: 现在连线达拉斯的罗伯·卡普兰，高盛副主席、前达拉斯联储主席。

segments.en: Rob, it's always great to have you on the program. A lot of us have not really heard too much and really know the new chairman here.
segments.zh: 罗伯，很高兴你上节目。我们很多人对新主席还不太了解。

segments.en: We learned that he's serious about not wanting to make predictions or give forward guidance.
segments.zh: 我们了解到他认真对待不做预测或前瞻指引。

segments.en: And he also learned that he's probably even gonna be careful about describing the Fed's reaction function.
segments.zh: 他还可能对描述美联储的反应函数非常谨慎。

segments.en: And then the last thing is, which was not surprising, there are four or five areas, and I think this is a good thing. He wants to review practices and that's why he's setting up these task forces.
segments.zh: 最后一点，不意外，有四五个领域，我认为这是好事。他想审查做法，所以设立这些工作组。

segments.en: And so we learned that he's serious about that, that the drawbacks of that approach or the adjustment the markets are having to make is he didn't really give a glimpse into the debate.
segments.zh: 所以我们了解到他对此很认真，这种方法的缺点或市场必须做出的调整是他没有透露辩论内容。

segments.en: The statement probably is the best guide you have and I'll make a comment on that.
segments.zh: 声明可能是你最好的指南，我会对此发表评论。
